description: Rejseplanen GTFS is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rejsekort & Rejseplan A/S. Static plan data in the standard GTFS format. Data contains timetables for trains and buses in Denmark and related geographical information. Coverage: Rejsekort & Rejseplan A/S. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS itinerary" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rejsekort & Rejseplan A/S. Its keywords include Offentlig Transport, Transportdata, Transport, ITS-direktivet, Retsakt-A, Tog. The listing shows 1 download or service links in TXT. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
